dataAndBackup.gdprReadme:
GlassFolio — Personal data export archive (GDPR Art. 15 and 20)
Generated on {{date}} in your browser: no data went through a server.

Contents:
- manifest.json: file list, item count per collection, secrets deliberately excluded.
- profile.json: your profile (identifier, email, name, preferences). Password hashes and salts are excluded.
- consent.json: your cookie / audience-measurement consent choice.
- security-summary.json: two-factor status and passkey count (no secrets).
- data/: full JSON backup and one CSV file per data type (spreadsheet-friendly).

Only data actually stored in your account is included; no demo data.
To exercise your other rights (rectification, objection, restriction), see the Privacy Policy.
